result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: overlapping restaurant metadata text in the popular list.

issues.description: In the “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” card, the details line under the restaurant name appears overlapped/garbled. The time and delivery information are drawn on top of each other, making the text hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the spacing or layout of the metadata row so each item has enough horizontal space, or truncate/wrap the text cleanly before it overlaps.
